- All videos must have the same aspect ratio.
- Synchronous - waits for completion.

info.name: Google Flow API v1 by useapi.net

description.content:
Experimental API for Google Flow with full support for Veo, Imagen 4, and Nano Banana.

**Features:**

- Multiple Google accounts with automated load balancing
    
- Real-time webhooks for job events (replyUrl parameter)
    
- Async mode for fire-and-forget video generation
    
- Dynamic concurrency management
    
- Image and video generation with reference image support
    

**Key Features:**

- Generate images with Imagen 4 and Nano Banana / Gemini 2.5 Flash Image
    
- Generate videos with Veo 3.1 Quality and Fast models
    
- T2V, I2V, I2V-FL, and R2V generation modes
    
- Reference images support (style and context references)
    
- Use free Google accounts for unlimited image generations
    
- Use Google AI Ultra subscription for unlimited Veo 3.1 Fast video generations
    

**Commands:**

- [POST /images](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-images) - Generate images with Imagen 4 or Nano Banana
    
- [POST /videos](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-videos) - Generate videos with Veo 3.1 Quality or Fast
    
- [POST /assets/<email>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-assets-email) - Upload assets (PNG, JPEG)
    
- [POST /videos/extend](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-videos-extend) - Extend video with a new prompt
    
- [POST /videos/concatenate](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-videos-concatenate) - Concatenate multiple videos
    
- [GET /jobs](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/get-google-flow-jobs) - Get load balancing statistics
    
- [GET /jobs/<jobid>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/get-google-flow-jobs-jobid) - Get job status and results
    
- [GET /accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/get-google-flow-accounts) - List all configured accounts
    
- [GET /accounts/<email>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/get-google-flow-accounts-email) - Get specific account configuration
    
- [POST /accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-accounts) - Configure Google Flow account
    
- [DELETE /accounts/<email>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/delete-google-flow-accounts-email) - Delete account configuration
    
- [GET /accounts/captcha-stats](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/get-google-flow-accounts-captcha-stats) - Query captcha solving statistics
    

Visit [https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1](https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1) for complete documentation.
